notes: Epileptic-seizure-count data: self-contained DATALINES (59 subjects, wide C0-C4) reshaped wide->long with DATA-step arrays and a do-loop, plus log/rate transforms, then PROC PRINT, PROC SORT, and PROC MEANS BY TRT*week (mean l_rate). The author's reshape and transform code is kept verbatim; the trailing SGPANEL/GEE modeling steps were dropped so the bundle focuses on the data-engineering and summary pipeline.
